rationale.complete: Round 1, round 1b on the improved data and round 2 (2026-10-05): a non-mention content response at matched lag (R2, 17 periods, both embedding models), the NE41 memory dose (R4, from local memory text) and an exposure audit (R5: fetch log, status blocks, a log-free monitor, the 200-event cap). Each round-2 estimator was validated on synthetic worlds first. The confirm script still uses the round-1 rule and has not run.
rationale.faithfulness: Read-out gating holds for addressing (14/17) and reply labels (17/17), beats a pseudo-message null and an other-room placebo (8/8), and every named rival for names and replies is beaten (H = 2). Round 2 narrows it: content moves toward a read message only inside the replies that name the sender; without names, the in-flight partition (co-response) wins. The memory-dose test is unpowered, ground truth covers one agent, and nothing is confirmed on reserved data.
rationale.usefulness: Concrete facts for an operator: reactions wait for the next model call; name the recipient to move its content; compaction cuts about a fifth of conversational coupling; a five-fetch event-age alarm catches a replayed feed within an active hour. Modest novelty, since gating follows from scaffold design.
